name: Callout
description: An arrow with a label that points at a spot on a shared screen or demo, with an optional softly pulsing ring at the tip.

params.name: direction
params.help: Where the arrow points; its tip sits near that edge of the layer box, so place the box next to the spot. For up/down use a taller box (e.g. w 0.14, h 0.25)

params.name: pulse
params.help: Softly pulsing ring at the arrow tip
